item: A nested statement_deadline restores the enclosing block's handler on exit instead of disarming the connection
summary: A block that opened its own deadline inside a member's deadline (the benchmark's framing case) disarmed the connection on exit; the enclosing deadline then could not stop a statement until the next transaction began, so the cases after it ran unbounded and the keyword lane's card_audit chose ordering over nesting. The enclosing handler is kept in session.info beside its expiry and put back on the held connection. A block with no enclosing one still disarms. The benchmark's ordering workaround (framing last) is no longer required but stays.
